*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  R_TYPE_OUT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       RPY_DYNPRO_READ:                                               *
*       Verarbeiten der internen Angaben zum Typ                       *
*       Aufbau des externen Typs                                       *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*      -->P_FIELD_INT    Dynprofeld intern                             *
*      <--P_DYNP_FIELD   Dynprofeld extern                             *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM R_TYPE_OUT
             USING    VALUE(P_FIELD_INT) TYPE DYNPRO_FIELD
             CHANGING P_DYNP_FIELD       TYPE RPYTY_DYNP_FIELD.

DATA: F_RES1 LIKE D021S_RES1.


  F_RES1 = P_FIELD_INT-RES1.

  CASE P_FIELD_INT-FILL.
    WHEN SPACE.                          "nichtgraf.
      IF P_FIELD_INT-LTYP = 'O'.
        P_DYNP_FIELD-TYPE = RPYTY_DYNP_FTYPE-OKCODE.
      ELSEIF P_FIELD_INT-FLG1 O FLG1EDT.
        P_DYNP_FIELD-TYPE = RPYTY_DYNP_FTYPE-TEMPLATE.
      ELSE.
        P_DYNP_FIELD-TYPE = RPYTY_DYNP_FTYPE-TEXT.
      ENDIF.
    WHEN '0'.                            "nichtgraf.; führ. Null
      IF P_FIELD_INT-FLG1 O FLG1EDT.
        P_DYNP_FIELD-TYPE = RPYTY_DYNP_FTYPE-TEMPLATE.
      ELSE.
        P_DYNP_FIELD-TYPE = RPYTY_DYNP_FTYPE-TEXT.
      ENDIF.
    WHEN 'C'.                            "Ankreuzfeld
      P_DYNP_FIELD-TYPE = RPYTY_DYNP_FTYPE-CHECK.
    WHEN 'A'.                            "Auswahlknopf
      P_DYNP_FIELD-TYPE = RPYTY_DYNP_FTYPE-RADIO.
    WHEN 'P'.                            "Drucktaste
